design.name: dgx-superpod-mixed
design.description: Mixed DGX SuperPOD — 1 SU DGX H200 (31 nodes, RDHx) + 1 SU DGX GB300 NVL72 (576 GPUs, DLC) on one Schneider chilled-water plant, modelled as IaC

hall.note: Row A: DGX H200 with Motivair ChilledDoor RDHx on every rack; row B: DGX GB300 NVL72 on direct liquid, GB300 mgmt racks on RDHx; CDUs at the row-B end, overhead coolant headers behind each row, Uniflair plant outside the +X hall wall, two HDCV CRAHs at the cold-aisle ends for the NVL72 residual air; overhead Starline busway per path (A/B/C), ladder rack and fibre raceway above each row. No aisle containment.
